description.value: Odd Burger is Canada's first fully vegan fast-food chain, founded in London, Ontario in 2014 and now operating locations across Canada. The company manufactures its own plant-based ingredients and built its brand on accessible, minimally processed vegan fast food — including what it calls the 'Famous Burger,' which sold out at a meat-centric Ontario ribfest in 2016. The Vancouver Main Street location opened in late 2024, bringing a mission-driven vegan fast food option to a well-trafficked urban cycling corridor.
